signature: SUBROUTINE ZGGEVX( BALANC, JOBVL, JOBVR, SENSE, N, A, LDA, B, LDB,

params.name: balanc
jobvl
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: do not compute the left generalized eigenvectors;
-   `= 'V'`: compute the left generalized eigenvectors.

params.name: jobvr
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: do not compute the right generalized eigenvectors;
-   `= 'V'`: compute the right generalized eigenvectors.

params.name: sense
N
params.reference: The order of the matrices A, B, `VL`, and `VR`. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the matrix A in the pair (A,B). On exit, A has been overwritten. If `JOBVL='V'` or `JOBVR='V'` or both, then A contains the first part of the complex Schur form of the "balanced" versions of the input A and B.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the matrix B in the pair (A,B). On exit, B has been overwritten. If `JOBVL='V'` or `JOBVR='V'` or both, then B contains the second part of the complex Schur form of the "balanced" versions of the input A and B.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: BETA
params.reference:
On exit, `ALPHA(j)`/`BETA(j)`, $j=1$,...,N, will be the generalized eigenvalues.

Note: the quotient `ALPHA(j)`/`BETA(j)` ) may easily over- or underflow, and `BETA(j)` may even be zero. Thus, the user should avoid naively computing the ratio `ALPHA`/`BETA`. However, `ALPHA` will be always less than and usually comparable with norm(A) in magnitude, and `BETA` always less than and usually comparable with norm(B).

params.name: VL
params.reference: If `JOBVL = 'V'`, the left generalized eigenvectors u(j) are stored one after another in the columns of `VL`, in the same order as their eigenvalues. Each eigenvector will be scaled so the largest component will have abs(real part) + abs(imag. part) = 1. Not referenced if `JOBVL = 'N'`.

params.name: ldvl
params.reference: The leading dimension of the matrix `VL`. $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge 1$, and if `JOBVL = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge N$.

params.name: VR
params.reference: If `JOBVR = 'V'`, the right generalized eigenvectors v(j) are stored one after another in the columns of `VR`, in the same order as their eigenvalues. Each eigenvector will be scaled so the largest component will have abs(real part) + abs(imag. part) = 1. Not referenced if `JOBVR = 'N'`.

params.name: ldvr
params.reference: The leading dimension of the matrix `VR`. $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge 1$, and if `JOBVR = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge N$.

params.name: ihi
params.reference: `ILO` and `IHI` are integer values such that on exit $A(i,j) = 0$ and $B(i,j) = 0$ if $i > j$ and $j = 1$,...,`ILO`-1 or $i = \mathrm{IHI}+1$,...,N. If `BALANC = 'N'` or 'S', `ILO = 1` and `IHI = N`.

params.name: LSCALE
params.reference:
Details of the permutations and scaling factors applied to the left side of A and B. If PL(j) is the index of the row interchanged with row j, and DL(j) is the scaling factor applied to row j, then

$$
\mathrm{LSCALE}(j) = \mathrm{PL}(j) \quad\text{for}\quad j = 1, \cdots ,\mathrm{ILO}-1
$$

$$
= \mathrm{DL}(j) \quad\text{for}\quad j = \mathrm{ILO}, \cdots ,\mathrm{IHI}
$$

$$
= \mathrm{PL}(j) \quad\text{for}\quad j = \mathrm{IHI}+1, \cdots ,N
$$

The order in which the interchanges are made is N to `IHI`+1, then 1 to `ILO`-1.

params.name: RSCALE
params.reference:
Details of the permutations and scaling factors applied to the right side of A and B. If PR(j) is the index of the column interchanged with column j, and DR(j) is the scaling factor applied to column j, then

$$
\mathrm{RSCALE}(j) = \mathrm{PR}(j) \quad\text{for}\quad j = 1, \cdots ,\mathrm{ILO}-1
$$

$$
= \mathrm{DR}(j) \quad\text{for}\quad j = \mathrm{ILO}, \cdots ,\mathrm{IHI}
$$

$$
= \mathrm{PR}(j) \quad\text{for}\quad j = \mathrm{IHI}+1, \cdots ,N
$$

The order in which the interchanges are made is N to `IHI`+1, then 1 to `ILO`-1.

params.name: abnrm
params.reference: The one-norm of the balanced matrix A.

params.name: bbnrm
params.reference: The one-norm of the balanced matrix B.

params.name: RCONDE
params.reference: If `SENSE = 'E'` or 'B', the reciprocal condition numbers of the eigenvalues, stored in consecutive elements of the array. If `SENSE = 'N'` or 'V', `RCONDE` is not referenced.

params.name: RCONDV
params.reference: If `JOB = 'V'` or 'B', the estimated reciprocal condition numbers of the eigenvectors, stored in consecutive elements of the array. If the eigenvalues cannot be reordered to compute `RCONDV(j)`, `RCONDV(j)` is set to 0; this can only occur when the true value would be very small anyway. If `SENSE = 'N'` or 'E', `RCONDV` is not referenced.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,2 \, N)$. If `SENSE = 'E'`, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,4 \, N)$. If `SENSE = 'V'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,2 \, N \, N+2 \, N)$.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: RWORK
params.reference: lrwork must be at least max(1,6\*N) if `BALANC = 'S'` or 'B', and at least max(1,2\*N) otherwise. Real workspace.

params.name: IWORK
params.reference: If `SENSE = 'E'`, `IWORK` is not referenced.

params.name: BWORK
params.reference: If `SENSE = 'N'`, `BWORK` is not referenced.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `= 1,...,N`:  The QZ iteration failed.  No eigenvectors have been calculated, but `ALPHA(j)` and `BETA(j)` should be correct for $j=\mathrm{INFO}+1$,...,N.
-   `> N`: =N+1: other than QZ iteration failed in ZHGEQZ. =N+2: error return from ZTGEVC.

untranslated: WORK.minLength: local MINWRK is assigned inside nested control flow
notes: no derivable minimum length for workspace RWORK
